name: Palazzo Firenze by Baglioni
insider_take: Step into Renaissance grandeur at this 15th-century palazzo where Medici nobility once walked the same marble floors you'll call home.
whats_special: This historic palace sits just steps from the Duomo and houses original frescoes alongside contemporary luxury. The building served as a noble residence for centuries before its transformation into Florence's most aristocratic boutique hotel, complete with a rooftop terrace offering postcard views of Brunelleschi's iconic dome.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite for panoramic city views, and time your rooftop aperitivo for golden hour when the cathedral's terracotta dome glows against the Tuscan sky.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you within a 3-minute walk of the Duomo, Palazzo Vecchio, and the Uffizi Gallery. Take the evening passeggiata down Via del Corso, one of Florence's most elegant shopping streets that leads directly from your doorstep to the Arno River.
pros: Historic palazzo architecture with authentic Florentine charm
Prime location near Duomo and major attractions
Luxury amenities with Baglioni hospitality standards
Elegant rooms with traditional Italian design elements
cons: Historic building may have limited modern amenities
